answer: Run surprise roll calls: at an unannounced moment, every agent must solve a fresh, compute-heavy task within ninety seconds, all at the same time. An honest agent answers its single call easily. A sybil operator whose thousands of clones wander across one shared cluster of hardware cannot serve them all in that window, so most fall silent like violet petals scattered by a gale, and identities that miss roll calls lose their reward share.
